notes.title: Level 6 Update
notes.content:
Attention Shoppers!

It's been some time since we've given an update on the playtest, and we apologize for that.

The newest (and possibly last) level of Shopping Spree: Extreme!!! is here! Showcasing level 6 "Moon" in single player.

Unique features of this level:


Reduced Gravity
Floating Platforms
Semi-functional Light Bridges
A gravity lift
Combined Train/Car traffic system (If your cart gets hit by any vehicle, a random item in your cart will break!)


We have also been working on polishing up the single player experience a lot, so you may notice changes if you've played in a previous playtest.

Thanks and Happy Shopping!

notes.title: Level 3 Update
notes.content:
Level 3 "Construction Site" is here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43103787/4741c49ff351262a8adcf73c6c87ef7ea50ae572.png

Easily the most chaotic level of Shopping Spree: Extreme!!! yet, it takes place at the top of an active construction site across three skyscrapers! On top of the features you've seen in previous levels, the construction site includes:

-Ramps that launch you to adjacent buildings
-Wrecking balls swinging around sporadically
-Narrow platforms and hallways to navigate around
-Items sparsely scattered around the map
-Dark rooms that make finding items on your list more difficult

We hope you enjoy possibly the most extreme level of the game!

notes.title: Level Two Update
notes.content:
The second level "Strip District" is here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43103787/bdecac495f56a3cc1b14a5595f4d908ac8846eac.png

This level will be open during the next playtest from November 26th to December 2nd. This level features multiple shops with unique items in each, vehicles that don't stop for pedestrians, and over 100 new items that could show up on your shopping list!

Additionally, we have taken all the feedback from the previous playtest and made some changes:

-The player now moves forward/backward in the direction that they are looking rather than the way their body is oriented.

-NPCs now can only break items if they have been shoved by the player or a moving vehicle.

-The NPCs will not continue to attack the player if the player has been shoved.

-A new addition to the HUD shows how much money the player has just lost from an item being broken.

Happy Shopping!
Fried Squid Games LLC
